MIDDLESEX COUNTY
SHERIFF'S SALE
26000011
SUPERIOR COURT
OF NEW JERSEY
CHANCERY DIVISION
MIDDLESEX COUNTY
DOCKET NO. F00615325
LAKEVIEW LOAN SERVICING, LLC, is
the Plaintiff, and JAVID IQBAL, ET
ALS., are Defendants, writ of execution for the sale of mortgaged
premises dated 12/11/2025.
By virtue of the above stated Writ,
to me directed and delivered, I will
expose to sale at public vendue on
WEDNESDAY, the 25TH DAY
FEBRUARY A,D. 2026, at the hour of
one thirty o' clock by the then
prevailing (Standard Daylight Saving) time, in the afternoon of the said day, at the Heldrich Hotel,
10 Livingston Ave, New Brunswick,
N.J. 08901.
The property to be sold is located
in the OLD BRIDGE TOWNSHIP,
County of Middlesex and State of
New Jersey.
Premises commonly known as: 21
CATHERINE COURT, SOUTH AMBOY (OLD BRIDGE TOWNSHIP) NJ 08879.
Tax Lot: 4 C0263, Tax Block: 2150
F/K/A Lot 266 Block 2150.38.
Dimensions of the Lot: (Approximately)
All that certain tract or parcel of
land, situated, lying and being in
Old Bridge Township, County of
Middlesex, and State of New
Jersey, more particularly described
as follows:
Unit No. 266 in Building No. 38,
together with an undivided
0.25839% Deed Shows .79365%
interest (6th amendment refers to
the percentage interest change) in
the Common Elements is located
substantially as delineated in the
Master Deed for "Bridgepointe
Condominium", as recorded in the
Office of the Clerk of Middlesex
County June 18, 1990 in Book
3859 of Deeds at Page 1, and as amended by deed book 4042, page 643; Deed Book 4884, Page 696;
Deed Book 4904, Page 128; Deed
Book 4933, Page 685; Deed Book
5005, Page 511; Deed Book 5041,
Page 381 and Deed Book 5871,
Page 25; and any amendments
thereto.
The sale is subject to any unpaid
taxes and assessments, tax, water
and sewer liens and other municipal
assessments. The amount due can
be obtained from the local taxing
authority. Pursuant to NJSA 46:8B-21 the sale may also be subject to
the limited lien priority of any
condominium/home-owner association liens which may exist. The
sale may be further subject to
restrictions, reversions, reservations, and easements af record.
The occupancy status of the
subject property is unknown.
The approximate upset sum is
$494,136.50 calculated through
December 22, 2025 plus any additional advance, interest, Sheriff's
cost and commission to the date of
sale.
SURPLUS MONEY: if after the sale
and satisfaction of the mortgage
debt, including costs and expenses,
there remains any surplus money,
the money will be deposited into
the Superior Court Trust Fund and
any person claiming the surplus, or
any part thereof, may file a motion
pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and
4:57-2 stating the nature and
extent of that person's claim and
asking for an order directing
payment of the surplus money. The
Sheriff or other person conducting
the sale will have information
regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount of the
upset to be satisfied by said sale is
the sum of FOUR HUNDRED FIFTY
FIVE THOUSAND NINE HUNDRED
THIRTY ONE DOLLARS AND NINETY
FIVE CENTS ($455,931.95) dollars
more or less, plus interest together
with the costs of this sale. THE
UPSET AMOUNT MAY BE SUBJECT
TO FURTHER ORDERS OF ADDITIONAL SUMS.
The subscriber reserves the right to
adjourn said sale from time to time
subject only to such limitations or
restrictions upon the exercise of
such power as may be specially
provided by law or rules of the
Court. Sold subject to conditions of
sale.
Successful bidder must pay 20% of
bid in certified check or official
bank check at close of sale and the
balance in two weeks.
Mildred S. Scott, Sheriff
Logs Legal Group LLP
14000 Commerce Parkway Suite B
Mount Laurel, NJ 08054
Attorneys
